title: A planned goal about a provider's answer is read against every providers.csv row that has that column, not only Microsoft Learn's
goal: precheck warns of a committed item whose goal or touches name a provider-registry column's behaviour (search_api, not_found, raw_form) when its checks plant only one provider's response, naming the other rows of providers.csv that fill the column; in SP-vdrsfftl BG-gx5b2yhu's goal and checks took a search answer without a results list as no answer, Learn's shape only, so GitHub and arXiv searches that answer 200 became unanswered (BG-o3zppi2w)

run:
import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir(); (t/'_tools').mkdir()
(t/'_tools'/'providers.csv').write_text('provider,match,search_api,not_found\nlearn,learn.microsoft.com/,https://learn.microsoft.com/api/search?search={q},hard-404\ngithub,github.com/,https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q={q},hard-404\narxiv,arxiv.org/,https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={q},soft-404\n')
def w(o): (d/(o['id']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(o))
w({'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'planned','goal':'g'})
goal = 'A search_api answer without a results list is no answer'
def item(iid, mention):
    w({'id':iid,'kind':'story','title':'t','status':'draft','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P3','rank':0,'goal':goal,
       'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; hosts = %r; sys.exit(1)' % mention]}]})
item('ST-aaaaaaa2', ['learn', 'learn.microsoft.com/'])
item('ST-bbbbbbb2', ['learn', 'learn.microsoft.com/', 'github', 'github.com/', 'arxiv', 'arxiv.org/'])
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'precheck','SP-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,text=True)
warn = lambda i: [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('warning:') and i in l]
a, b = warn('ST-aaaaaaa2'), warn('ST-bbbbbbb2')
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and a and 'arxiv' in a[0] and 'github' in a[0] and not b else 1)
